subject: grad
title: (R)GRAD.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 245 (CMOA(II)-3). GRAD (gradualism) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and POL-P (political policies). From SOC-RT-DY: RT-ALGN (reality alignment). From POL-P: MPT (manipulation) and INT (intention). From MPT: INFO-INTR (information interpretation). From INT: STF (source transfer). From INFO-INTR: POL-SIGN (political significance).
